# Switzerland, Basel-Landschaft — 2025

> Benchmark chips for Switzerland cut from the 2025 edition of the harmonized field boundary collection ch.

- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/ch_bl_2025/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/ch_bl_2025/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/ch_bl_2025/ch_bl_2025_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/ch_bl_2025/ch_bl_2025_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/ch_bl_2025/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/ch_bl_2025/ch_bl_2025_fields.parquet)
